senses.gloss:
Muṇḍibha Audanya^1 or Audanyava^2 is the name of a man
in the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa^1 and the Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa.^2
1) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, xiii. 3, 5, 4.
Apparently the word is a patronymic,
‘son of Udanya’ (so Eggeling, Sacred
Books of the East, 44, 341, n. 1), or
‘son of Odana’ (so St. Petersburg
Dictionary, s.v.).
2) Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa, iii. 9, 15, 3
(‘descendant of Udanyu’).
